name: admin.py backup: one run backs up projects and publishes a validated status file
summary: admin.py backup [NAMES | --all] backs up each initialized project as a pair (the native backup under backups/NAME and the coordination sidecar backups/NAME.coordination.json) and writes one status file for the run: each project complete (with its pair paths and time), failed or skipped (with a reason), and the run complete only when every entry is. The record is validated before it is written or trusted (validate_backup_status refuses an unknown status or scope, a complete entry without its exact pair, an empty list, a run status that disagrees with its entries). restore-new restores a project from that pair.
